active customer: a customer with at least one invoice dated within 12 months of the most recent invoice_date in the database
support representative: an employee who appears as customer.support_rep_id for at least one customer; other employees are not
sold track: a track appearing in at least one invoice_line; a track never purchased is not one
charting artist: an artist with at least one track that appears in an invoice_line, joined through album
active genre: a genre with at least one track that appears in an invoice_line
curated playlist: a playlist containing at least one track; an empty playlist is not one
average order value: the mean of invoice.total across invoices; one order is one invoice, never one invoice_line
credited track: a track whose composer is not null
